name: Google Sheets
description: Source + destination connector for Google Sheets via the Sheets v4 REST API. Each sheet tab is treated as a table; the first row is the header. As a source it reads rows offset-paged (export); as a destination it appends rows (import_data) and auto-creates tabs. OAuth2 with the 'google' provider.

supported_auth_methods.description: OAuth 2.0 via the 'google' provider with the spreadsheets scope.

spreadsheet_id.description: Google Sheets workbook ID — the long string between /d/ and /edit in the URL (docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/{ID}/edit).

access_token.description: OAuth2 access token with the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets scope. Populated by the Google OAuth callback.

spreadsheet_id.description: Google Sheets workbook ID — the long string between /d/ and /edit in the URL.

access_token.description: OAuth2 access token with the spreadsheets scope.

config_fields.name: spreadsheet_id
config_fields.description: Google Sheets workbook ID — the long string between /d/ and /edit in the URL.
config_fields.ui_help_text: Open your workbook, copy the ID between /d/ and /edit in the URL.

config_fields.name: access_token
config_fields.description: OAuth2 access token with the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets scope.
config_fields.ui_help_text: Populated automatically after you connect a Google account.

operations.name: test_connection
operations.description: Verify access to the configured workbook (returns the workbook title).

operations.name: validate_config
operations.description: Static validation — confirm required fields present without an API call.

operations.name: discover_schema
operations.description: List sheet tabs (treated as tables) and their header columns.

parameters.name: max_tables
parameters.description: Maximum number of tabs to return.

operations.name: get_capabilities
operations.description: Return connector capabilities for agent interaction.

operations.name: export
operations.description: Read rows from a tab (offset-paged). Each tab is a table; row 1 is the header; data starts at row 2.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Tab name to read (aliases: tab, sheet, resource, endpoint, object).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max rows to return per call. The executor passes its own batch size.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of data rows to skip (0 = first data row below the header).

operations.name: ensure_table
operations.description: Create missing tab + write the header row. Idempotent.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: List of column names to use as the header row.

parameters.name: pipeline_id
parameters.description: Optional pipeline ID recorded in the _rsync_pipelines metadata tab.

operations.name: import_data
operations.description: Append rows to a tab via values:append.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: List of row dicts. Keys not in the header row are ignored; missing keys become empty strings.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Optional explicit column order; defaults to the tab's header row.
